description: This file is a C header file declaring functions related to USP Service functionality, including start/stop routines, request queuing, response handling, and creation of register messages.

methods.name: USP_SERVICE_Stop
methods.description: Stop or terminate the USP Service.

methods.name: USP_SERVICE_QueueRegisterRequest
methods.description: Enqueue a registration request given an endpoint ID and objects.

methods.name: USP_SERVICE_HandleRegisterResp
methods.description: Handle a registration response message for a given endpoint.

methods.name: USP_SERVICE_QueueDeregisterRequest
methods.description: Enqueue a deregistration request given an endpoint ID and objects.

methods.name: USP_SERVICE_AsController_IsExpectedResponse
methods.description: Check if a message is an expected response when acting as a controller.

methods.name: USP_SERVICE_SetBrokerAgent
methods.description: Set the broker agent for a given endpoint.

methods.name: USP_SERVICE_CreateRegisterReq
methods.description: Create a registration request message, with options for partial registration and specified paths.
